mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 3.0% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, it signals an overheating economy that triggers a monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and UNRATE < 4.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market initially interprets labor market strength as a positive for economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals weak housing market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects broader economic weakness and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1300 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 and retail sales (RSAFS) falls below 500,000 million dollars, it signals a simultaneous contraction in supply and demand, indicating a deepening economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105 and RSAFS < 500000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher retail sales figure (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth and reduces recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS is above 490,000 million dollars (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher employment level (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above 145,000 thousand persons (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
